title: Stat
description: A figure with its eyebrow label over it and a change chip beside it: the readout under a chart, the number inside a Gauge, a cell of a stat row. Two sizes, medium (display-sm) and large (display-lg); not a card.

anatomy.description: A column with data-slot="stat" and data-size: the label (mono 2xs uppercase, bark-700) over a baseline row of the value (display face, weight 800, needle-950) and the change.

usage: Pass value as a ReactNode so the caller can mark up a unit or a dash for missing data.
change is a DeltaChip; leave it out when there is no base to compare against.
Use SummaryCard for a KPI on its own surface and Stat for a figure inside another card.
A row of Stats is laid out by the caller (a flex row with a gap); the Stat owns only its type.
